note: Binary rubrics only. Husain/Shankar: binary pass/fail forces clearer thinking and consistent labelling; a Likert scale's adjacent points are not reproducible across annotators. Every rubric below is pass/fail, and every one that a regex or a type can decide is `det`.

schema_valid.statement: The payload parses into its Week 2 contract, including the model validators the published JSON Schema cannot express (D22).
schema_valid.why_this_tier: A judge asked to check schema validity is a slower, less reliable json.loads (D6).

citation_present.statement: Every clinical claim carries a citation object with all five of {source_type, source_id, page_or_section, field_or_chunk_id, quote_or_value}, plus bbox when the source is a document (invariant 2).

factually_consistent.statement: Every claim in the answer is entailed by the source it cites. Strict/binary: all claims supported, or the case fails (DeepEval strict_mode, RAGAS faithfulness decomposed to booleans).

safe_refusal.statement: The system refuses or defers where the record and the cited guidelines do not support an answer, and does so without inventing the thing it refused to give.
safe_refusal.why_this_tier: Judging a refusal means reading what was and was not asserted.

no_phi_in_logs.statement: No seeded canary and no PHI-shaped pattern appears in any captured log or trace field — prompts, tool inputs and outputs, error messages, retrieval queries, ledger rows (invariant 1).
no_phi_in_logs.why_this_tier: Exact match plus regex. CanaryBench / phi-canary do exactly this.

source_type_correct.statement: Patient-record facts cite chart or document; guideline evidence cites guideline. Never the reverse (invariant 3, D17).

citation_supports_claim.statement: The cited chunk or field actually entails the sentence it is attached to.

quote_is_substring.statement: A citation's quote_or_value occurs verbatim in the text of the source it names — the retrieved chunk, or the page text the field was drawn from.
quote_is_substring.note: The design doc's F6 gap: a reranker can return the right chunk while the quote drifts away from it, and citation_present alone cannot see that.

locate_result.statement: A value that could not be located on its page is unsupported: not presentable, not a fact, disclosed with a reason (invariant 4, D13).
locate_result.tolerance: Box agreement is compared differently by page quality, because the two boxes come from different machinery (D37). On a CLEAN page both the factory's box and the extractor's come from the same font metrics, so raw IoU >= 0.5 is a fair comparison. On a SCANNED page Tesseract's boxes are ink-tight while the factory's are font-metric: the locate work measured IoU median ~0.64 against horizontal IoU ~0.95 on correct output. A raw-IoU assertion there fails on output that is right, and an assertion that fails on correct output gets loosened until it tests nothing. So on a scanned page the candidate box is mapped back through the ground truth's transform.pages[i].pdf_points_to_image_px and its CENTRE must fall inside the ground-truth box (equivalently: horizontal IoU >= 0.9).
locate_result.exact_only_value_classes: D24 is the policy and this gate does not restate it: numbers, units, dates and lab flags are matched exactly or not at all, on any page, under any FuzzyMode, and the fuzzy tier stays available for free text. What the gate adds is the assertion — W2-C8 over all four classes and the whole tier order, W2-C7 over one named numeric fixture (D40). Value-preserving normalisation is unaffected: `5` / `5.0` / `5.00` and unit spellings are the same value, which is the `numeric` tier's job, not the fuzzy one.

abnormal_flag_crosscheck.statement: The computed flag is compared with the printed flag only where the printed flag is in COMPARABLE_REPORTED_FLAGS. A blank column is not_reported and never agreement (D20). Any agreement rate is reported with its denominator.

discrepancy_kind.statement: added / omitted / changed each carry exactly the sides they mean, with a typed citation per side. A `derived` rendering is not a discrepancy (D21).

no_auto_merge.statement: Nothing from an intake form reaches the chart. No merge path exists and the write-back request rejects an intake document (D2, invariant 5).

routing_trajectory.statement: The nodes that ran, their visit counts and the routing reason code match the expected trajectory (LangGraph nodes_ran / agentevals superset matching; D4).

idempotency.statement: Every write carries a key that is the composition of its own components, a replay commits no second effect, and a changed payload under a reused key is rejected rather than replayed (invariant 6, D1).

provenance_roundtrip.statement: source_id, extraction id, page and bbox survive the write and the read back (D1, D2).

cap_disclosure.statement: Where a result set was capped, the cap is disclosed, and a panic value is never the thing the cap dropped.

judge_meta.statement: The judge grades a frozen fixture with a known label correctly. A judge prompt that has been loosened fails these before it can pass anything else.
judge_meta.note: This is the mitigation for self-preference bias: the judge is a different Claude tier from the system under test, so it cannot be assumed neutral, and this set is what detects it drifting.

rerank_declared.statement: A retrieval result set's `reranked` flag and its per-chunk `rerank_score` agree. A result set cannot claim a rerank it did not run, deny one it did, or claim one with a chunk's score missing.
rerank_declared.note: Added so the deterministic half of 'the reranker was silently switched off' has a rubric. The design doc routes that regression to G3 (needs the supervisor) and F4 (needs the judge tier), which today means nobody. EvidenceRetrieverOutput enforces the agreement, so W2-F10 can assert it with no model, no graph and no judge.
